newsitem.title: USA: TRAVELERS TO REDEEM $300 MLN OF PREFERENCE SHARES.
newsitem.headline: TRAVELERS TO REDEEM $300 MLN OF PREFERENCE SHARES.

text.p: Travelers Group said Friday it will redeem all 1.2 million of its 8.125 percent cumulative preferred stock series A on July 28 for $250 per share plus accrued and unpaid dividends.
A spokesman said the company was making the redemptions because of "favorable market conditions"

The aggregate principal amount of the series A preferred stock outstanding as of June 12, 1997 was $300 million, the company said. The 1.2 million preferred shares equal 12 million depositary shares, which will be redeemed at $25 per share plus accrued and unpaid dividends, it added.
Dividends on the preferred stock and the depositary shares, which each represent one-tenth of a preferred share, will cease to accrue on July 28, Travelers said.
BankBoston Corp is the depositary for the preferred stock and depositary shares. An official notice of redemption will be mailed shortly to all holders.
Travelers Group is a diversified financial services company, with about $154 billion in assets. Friday, 13 June 1997 17:33:04
